name: Steadybit
description:
Steadybit is a reliability and chaos engineering platform. This connector lets Claude work with your own Steadybit tenant: explore what you run, design and execute chaos experiments against it, and interpret the results.

**Discover your systems**
Browse environments, teams, and services. Search targets — hosts, containers, Kubernetes workloads, cloud resources — with Steadybit's query language, inspect their attributes, and see which chaos actions your teams are allowed to use.

**Design and run experiments**
Search and read existing experiment designs, draft new ones from a plain-language description, create them from your own templates, and start or cancel runs. Steadybit's AI can suggest experiments tailored to a service and its weak points.

**Understand what happened**
Review past executions step by step, read execution logs, query the metrics recorded during a run, and pull reliability advice and service risk reports. Ask why an experiment failed and get an analysis grounded in the actual run data, not guesswork.

Everything Claude sees is scoped to your own permissions: the connector acts as you, limited to your teams, their environments, and the actions they may run. Read-only tools are annotated as such, and starting an experiment is marked destructive, so Claude asks before injecting a fault.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Steadybit to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Steadybit to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://platform.steadybit.com/mcp/demo. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Steadybit MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Steadybit lists 30 MCP tools, including analyze_execution, cancel_execution, create_experiment, create_experiment_from_template, draft_experiment, get_action, get_execution, get_execution_log, get_execution_metric, get_execution_report, get_experiment, and get_reliability_advice.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Steadybit?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Steadybit in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
Steadybit requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Steadybit is developed by Steadybit. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
